Subject: SDK preflight & API key handoff — scheduled office hours

Hi Tim,

Quick confirmation — our 30-minute office hours for SDK handoff and API key exchange is scheduled for Thursday, May 4 at 10:00 AM PT. During the session I'll cover:
- API key provisioning and scope assignment
- SDK quickstart (install, auth flow, sample call)
- A short integration smoke test (token exchange + sample inference)

Please have the engineer who will be integrating (or a screen-share) ready and the service account email available so I can provision keys. If you have any firewall restrictions, please let me know and we can pre-authorize the egress ranges.

I've attached a short preflight checklist to help the session go faster. If the time doesn't work, reply with a couple alternate slots and we'll reschedule.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi | Customer Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

We started the session at 10:00 AM PT and it looks like no one joined from Brightlane. No worries — schedules slip.

If you still want the walkthrough, here are 30-minute windows that work for our team:
- Fri May 7, 9:00–9:30 AM PT
- Mon May 10, 11:00–11:30 AM PT
- Tue May 11, 8:30–9:00 AM PT

If none of those fit, please send two times that do and we'll confirm. In the meantime, I've re-attached the preflight checklist and included a short runbook in case your engineer wants to try the smoke test before we meet.

Also, if you can share the service account email or a short network trace showing the call to your side (if you tried to connect), that will help us debug faster.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you unblocked.

Best,
Irene

Hey Irene,

So sorry — an incident pulled our on-call and we couldn't step away. Definitely still want this. Of the times you suggested, Fri May 7 at 9:00 AM PT looks best for us. If that no longer works, Mon May 10 at 11:00 AM PT is our backup.

Quick notes from our side: we did attempt the sample call yesterday and saw a network timeout. I've attached a short trace (brightlane_trace_0504.txt) — nothing sensitive, just connection timing. Thanks for the follow-up — we'll be on the call on Friday if that works.

—Tim

Brightlane

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Sanders <tim.sanders@brightlane.co>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-04T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SDK preflight & API key handoff — troubleshooting steps + confirm

Hi Tim — thanks for the trace and the quick reply. Apologies you hit that timeout. A couple of things we commonly see and quick checks you can run before the session (or we'll run them together on Fri):

1) SDK preflight (run on the host that will integrate):
   curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health 
   # expect HTTP 200 and a short JSON body

2) Egress and firewall: please ensure outbound access to api.redwood.ai on TCP 443 is allowed and that your NAT preserves SNI.

3) If you're using a proxy, set HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY in the environment or use the SDK's proxy config.

4) SDK version: run `pip show redwood-sdk` or `npm ls @redwood/sdk` and paste the version in the thread.

I've attached a tiny diagnostic helper (sdk-diagnostic-script.sh) that runs the curl check and prints the TLS handshake details — you can share the output if it still fails.

We're holding Fri May 7 9:00 AM PT for you. I'll join as well and we can provision a service-account key live if we confirm the connection. Attachments: sdk-diagnostic-script.sh

—Dev
Dev Patel | Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachment: sdk-diagnostic-script.sh (text/x-sh)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

- 5m introductions / roles

- 5m smoke test and next steps

Invite (ICS) attached and the Google Calendar link is here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=fr-may7-0900pt

Cheers,
Ben Carter | Account Executive
